description: Dependency tripwire: an @obliosoftware/oblioapi release usually means the Oblio API itself changed — review the SDK diff against src/schemas.ts before merging.

prBodyNotes: **Oblio shipped an SDK update — likely an API change.** Review the upstream diff (https://github.com/OblioSoftware/OblioApiJs) and check whether `src/schemas.ts` / the tool modules need updating. The weekly docs-drift workflow may open a companion PR.
